metadata.case_name: LO YIM FONG v. HO PO YIN AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: clerk (employed by Hong Kong Product Promotion Company Limited)

injuries.description: soft tissue sprain of her neck, with no bony fracture or neurological deficit;
source: (1) soft tissue sprain of her neck, with no bony fracture or neurological deficit;
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain with musculoskeletal signs

injuries.description: soft tissue sprain of her back, with no bony fracture or neurological deficit;
source: (2) soft tissue sprain of her back, with no bony fracture or neurological deficit;
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: abrasions at right upper chest and right lower leg.
injuries.body_part: right upper chest and right lower leg
source: (3) abrasions at right upper chest and right lower leg.

manifestations.description:
On and off neck soreness.
· Worse with prolonged computer usage (over 15 minutes).
· Better after a rest for 5 minutes.
· Sometime with radiation to bilateral temporal region.
· Improved by 50% after treatment.

On and off lower back pain
· Worse with prolonged sitting or walking (30 minutes), sleeping
· Better after a rest for 10 minutes.
· No improvement despite treatment.

On and off bilateral patella soreness
· Worse with prolonged walking, especially in staircase.
· Onset 3 months ago.

treatments_received: taken to Yan Chai Hospital for treatment
treated and/or examined by 5 separate medical institutions
orthopaedic examination and joint medical report by Dr Wong See Hoi and Dr Lam Kwong Chin (examination on 13 December 2010, joint report dated 6 January 2011)
treatments_future: MRI scan or surgery not indicated

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: She has reduced her badminton games from twice to once a week.
